No second JSON endpoint, XHR, or fetch call was found in a full network-request capture of the page load (30 requests total, exactly one JSON artifact). The six models' JS bundle DOES reference them by slug in a small 'default effort to show in UI' lookup table unrelated to score data, confirming DeepSWE's frontend build is genuinely aware of these models even though the fetched JSON isn't. CONCLUSION: this file's score rows were produced by DIGITIZING the rendered SVG chart directly — reading each point's pixel x/y position and converting to (cost, score) using an axis calibration derived from the chart's own gridline labels (x-axis: $0 -> 890.0px, $5.00 -> 587.514942367293px, $10 -> 285.02988473458606px; y-axis: 0% -> 546.0px, 80% -> 44.0px; both linear scales; the calibration self-checks exactly against the $10 gridline, recovering 9.999999999999998 when applied to its own defining point). This is a DIGITIZED-CHART read (source_type digitized_chart, evidence_grade D per this pack's grade convention — see e.g. performance/anthropic-sonnet5-digitized-2026-07.json), meaningfully LESS reliable than a raw-JSON-payload read elsewhere in this pack, and its numbers actively CONTRADICT the co-hosted machine-readable artifact on the same domain. Treat every score below as approximate (single-pixel-cluster reads, no stated error bars) and flag this file for a mandatory recheck once DeepSWE's leaderboard-live.json artifact is confirmed re-synced to match its own displayed chart (recheck no earlier than 2026-09-29, consistent with this pack's other board-recheck cadence).
